title: paper-story story.json
description: Narrative reconstruction with whys (axis, storyline, drift), logic extraction (keypoint, chain with warrants), and the two presentation products' content (one-page lab format + multi-page deck) plus talk and terms.

schema.description: @2 (2026-09-03): drift rows carry quote; quotes checked against source/paper.txt (S10); coverage.skipped honoured (S11). @3 (2026-09-03, co-upgrade round 1): drift[].kind from the narrative-axis.md §4 tell list + coverage.drift_checklist {kind: found|none} (S13); onepage.figures[].kind evidence|schematic|motivation — the one-page carries evidence figures only (S4c). Round-2 optional additions (2026-09-03, id unchanged): quote_source, coverage.checklist_provenance, logic.reused_from; Cover highlights ≤ 6. @4 (2026-09-04, user finding: the slogan alone was unreadable — its role nouns had no referent): logic.keypoint is the SLOGAN (not over-abstract), logic.keypoint_description is the 讀書心得終極詮釋, logic.bindings[] binds every role of the slogan to the paper's referent (S15), chain[].in_this_paper carries the concrete event sentence per step (S2); onepage.keypoint_box is gone (the strip prints the slogan verbatim); optional logic.patterns / logic.relations feed the library's KEYPOINTS index. @5 (2026-09-14, round 4 — the advisor's emphasis + the user's 「講稿生硬」 finding, three reference decks): brief {problem, approach, differs, conversation, methods[], verdicts[]} answers up front why read / every method / did it work / how judged (S18); deck.pages[] carry asks / bridge / takeaway / beat and figure_read {look, see, against, means} on figure pages, no_figure on content pages without one (S19); talk.story_arc {spine, craft[]} is how the paper tells its story (S20); notes open with their bridge and never recite a highlight (S20). @6 (user ruling 2026-11-03, the senior's ten-paper deck + a 3-paper blind test; @5 stays valid, readers accept both): onepage.figures[] are TILES grouped by argument step (step context|series|trend|mechanism|side-evidence, files[] for a multi-panel tile, why, necessity on a side-evidence tile, figure_read, notes) — story mode 3–4 tiles plus at most one side-evidence tile, deep mode keeps 3–6 (S4, S4d); onepage.fields four|five (default five) makes the Features cell optional; onepage.script {source_line, purpose_line} is the story-mode spoken walk. Behaviour of the new fields is only gated on @6 runs

id.description: == the run folder name. Until 2026-09-04: YYYYMMDD_<Author><year>_<slug> (the ingest date); after the library migration (naming-over-routing, user ruling 2026-09-04): <FirstAuthor><Year>_<short-title-slug>, no date — the folder is the paper's identity, calibration copies live under _calibration/

mode.description: deep = the next single-paper talk: every node, deck + talk REQUIRED; story = one page per paper for the ten-paper format: nodes N0–N3 + the one-page product, deck/talk optional (S5/S9 SKIP when absent); triage = axis card only (untested)

keypoint.description: the SLOGAN: one sentence of abstracted construction logic, ≤ 90 CJK-eq (S16 WARN), no material names, no numbers, no figure numbers (Test 0: a rule, not an event) — but NOT over-abstract (user ruling 2026-09-04, Test 0c): every role noun carries the qualifier that tells a reader which kind of thing it stands for (製程副作用, 面型自由度, 沉積化學根源 — never bare 副作用, 自由度, 根源). Printed verbatim by every product; bindings[] binds each role to the paper's referent

keypoint_description.description: the 讀書心得的終極詮釋 (user ruling 2026-09-04): one or two narrative paragraphs, 200–700 CJK-eq (S16 WARN outside), that a reader who has NOT read the paper can follow — what the authors faced, what they did first / next / last with the paper's concrete nouns beside each abstract move, why each move follows, what the reader takes away. Required on @4; rendered under the strip's 展開解讀 toggle, on the one-page's 解讀 page, on the deck's Keypoint page and in the record §1

role.description: a noun or verb phrase copied VERBATIM from keypoint (S15 checks the substring)

referent.description: what it stands for in THIS paper, with the paper's own nouns — the sentence Test 0 rejects AS the keypoint is exactly what belongs here

bindings.description: role → referent table (user finding 2026-09-04: 形狀, 載體, 自由度, 模型, 最低點 had no referent on the page and could not be resolved even after reading the paper). Every clause of the slogan (split on ；) carries ≥ 1 binding, ≥ 3 in total (S15 FAIL on @4); the one-page strip decorates each role with a hover card 在這篇＝referent

patterns.description: 1–3 kebab-case slugs naming the reusable logic pattern(s) the slogan instantiates (side-effect-as-boundary, one-free-variable-scan, replace-root-cause, …); the library's KEYPOINTS.md groups papers by them so Obsidian shows which papers share a construction logic (2026-09-04)

run.description: run id (folder name) of another library run

why.description: how the two logics meet: same pattern, the opposite move, the design side of the same device, the paper this one answers…

relations.description: explicit links to other library runs; the per-paper keypoint.md note renders them as wikilinks (2026-09-04)

step.description: the move in abstract form (a rule)

in_this_paper.description: the same move as the concrete event in THIS paper, with the paper's nouns (required on @4, S2 FAIL when empty or a restatement of step) — the explanatory text the user found missing on 2026-09-04

reused_from.description: run id of the deep (story) run whose key point / chain this run reuses — the rule for a story-mode page on a paper already in the library (round 2, run S1): the ten-paper page must agree with the single-paper talk

fields.description: @6 (user ruling 2026-11-03 G2): the table has four fields (Structure / Method / Result / Conclusion, the senior's ten-paper pages) or five (+ Features, deck B / deck C pages). Absent = five. With four, table.features is not required and is not printed

script.description: @6 story mode (user ruling 2026-11-03 G5): the senior's spoken pattern for a ten-paper page — one source line, one purpose line, then each tile's notes (axes -> what is seen -> what it means; never read the table aloud)

source_line.description: year + venue sentence, e.g. 這邊是 2021 年發表在 … 的文章

purpose_line.description: one sentence: what the paper set out to study (主要是探討 …)

file.description: one image file; a tile with several panels uses files[] (when both are present files[] wins and file is ignored)

files.description: @6 (user ruling 2026-11-03 G1): every image of ONE tile in reading order; a series' sub-panels go into one tile

step.description: @6: the argument step this tile carries — context (process flow / structure), series (raw series across the knob), trend (extracted parameter vs the knob, fits), mechanism (explanatory schematic), side-evidence (not the argument's focus but a necessary condition of the claim or usable as argument evidence; user wording 2026-11-03: 重點旁證 … 還是可以加入圖片). S4d WARNs when a tile has no step

why.description: @6: why this tile is on the page — the argument step it carries, in the audience's words

necessity.description: @6, required on step side-evidence: why the claim needs this figure (the necessary condition it establishes, or the argument it can serve as evidence for). A figure that only explains a side cause (sputter-target XRD) does not qualify and goes to the record

figure_read.description: @6: the same look / see / against / means walk deep mode keeps on deck pages, for this tile

notes.description: @6: the spoken walk for this tile — axes, what is seen, what it means (story-mode 口述稿; never reads the table aloud)

kind.description: evidence = the data a claim rests on (plots, spectra, micrographs of the made thing, results tables); schematic = the paper's OWN process flow / device drawing (the picture behind the Structure / Method cells, may stay on the one-page); motivation = overview / application scenario — deck ONLY (S4c WARN). Rulings 2026-09-03 Gb9 narrowed by OQ-1; required on schema @3

keypoint_box.description: schema ≤ @3 only (≤ 80 CJK-eq, the keypoint sentence + optional 為什麼讀它 clause). Gone on @4: the field invited a SECOND compression of an already-abstract sentence (Bose 68 → 59 CJK-eq with the cap never reached; Zhang carried a duplicate 為什麼讀它) — user finding 2026-09-04. The strip now prints logic.keypoint verbatim; S4 WARNs when the field is still present on @4

minutes.description: optional talk slot in minutes; absent = no slot, completeness wins and S17 skips the spoken estimate (user ruling round 5, 2026-09-14)

section.description: Keypoint | Cover | Introduction | Method | Results | Discussion | Conclusion | Closing (the paper's own section names may be used)

highlights.description: ≤ 3 on every page (a slide is a 重點提醒); the Cover page may list up to 6 = the N outline parts (S9 compares them)

layer.description: time layer (researcher.tw B-12, user ruling R5 2026-09-14): A never cut (Keypoint, the main Results page), B compressed first (speak its first highlight only), C dropped first. Practice products only; S17 warns on partial declaration

asks.description: @5: the one question this page answers, in the audience's words. Read in order, the asks[] of a deck ARE its storyline (the explainer's 口述稿 section prints the chain); S20 warns when a page after the Outline has none

bridge.description: @5: the transition sentence that ties this page to the previous page's open question; must appear verbatim inside notes (S20) — the 0914 reference decks' 「因此／但是如果只…所以／為了進一步解釋…」 move

takeaway.description: @5: the one-sentence so-what of the page, printed on the slide (class A and class B) — deck E's 「TBO improves Vth, but introduces an ON-state resistance penalty」 line

beat.description: @5: which storyline beat (①–⑥, ⑤′…) this page carries

figure_read.description: @5, required on a page with a figure (S19): the 這張圖怎麼看 walk — look (what the axes / panels / symbols are), see (the pattern, with numbers read off the figure), against (the comparison the figure makes: model, control, prior work, other condition — required on Results pages), means (what it proves and where it stops)

no_figure.description: @5: why an Introduction / Method / Results page carries no figure (figures are the first thing a page gets — advisor, 2026-09-14); S19 warns when such a page has neither

kind.description: question type (researcher.tw B-13): clarify = a fact the audience missed; challenge = the method or claim is questioned; extend = what it means beyond the paper

challenge.description: for kind challenge: admit → reason (why this choice, from the axis card) → settle (the evidence that would decide it). The first two challenges become backup pages in the legacy talk-deck.html (--legacy-html); S17 warns on a missing part

story_arc.description: @5 (advisor 2026-09-14: 能上頂級期刊的論文都很會說故事，這套流程值得學): how THIS paper tells a research story — spine = the And-But-Therefore sentence; craft[] = the moves a writer can copy, each with why it works on a reader and where it is. Printed as the explainer's 故事線 section (class A) and the Storyline page (class B); S20 warns under 4 craft steps or a step without why_it_works

brief.description: @5 (advisor 2026-09-14: 一開始就說明為什麼要讀、所有方法是什麼、最終有沒有達到、怎麼判讀; Pratt's three note questions): problem = the concrete bottleneck, not the topic (Q1); approach = data / method / path in one sentence (Q2); differs = what separates it from the other approaches (Q3); conversation = the locator of the citation-dense paragraph that says which academic conversation it joins; methods[] = EVERY method with what it answers; verdicts[] = each goal with how it was judged, the result and a status. Printed on the Verdict page (class A + B) and spoken on the front pages (S18)

name.description: the short name the presenter SAYS (S18 looks for it in the front notes)

answers.description: the question this method answers — not what it is

judged_by.description: the instrument / analysis / criterion that decides it — 怎麼判讀的

term.description: the exact surface form used on the pages (Chinese or English)

gloss.description: Wikipedia page-preview style: 1–2 sentences, what it is and why it matters here

en.description: English slide text for class B (lab_deck.py, 2026-09-04): keypoint (the slogan in English), table (five cells), figures {file: short caption} for the ten-papers page; for the single-paper deck also why_read, helps, keypoint_title, outline_parts[], pages {"<n>": {title, highlights[], caption}}, venue, date. Authored by the model at N4 so the formal deck can be built any time; never generated by machine translation

coverage.description: units of source/structure.json the reading deliberately did not use, each with a why (S11); and the drift tell list walked, each kind found or none (S13)

drift_checklist.description: the narrative-axis.md §4 tell list walked: every kind marked found (a drift row carries it) or none (looked for, not present) — S13 warns for a kind neither found nor declared; required on schema @3

checklist_provenance.description: authored (default) = the reader walked the list while reading; backfilled = the kinds were classified after the fact (OQ-2, 2026-09-03) and a none means 'no row of that kind', not a declared search — S13 says so
